recognize_zh: 極低倍下整個淋巴結被一致的淋巴細胞浸潤取代，隱約可見大小相近、邊界模糊的結節輪廓；下方的淋巴細胞穿出被膜進入周圍脂肪組織，形成小結節。
features: Scanning power: lymph node diffusely replaced by lymphoid infiltrate with vague, closely packed nodules of similar size
Nodules poorly delineated with attenuated/absent mantle zones
Thin capsule at lower edge with lymphoid aggregates extending into perinodal adipose tissue
No obvious preserved sinuses or normal nodal compartments
Hemorrhage in perinodal tissue at lower right corner
describe_en: Low-power H&E section of lymph node shows effacement of the normal architecture by a lymphoid infiltrate forming vague, closely packed nodules of relatively uniform size without well-formed mantle zones. The subcapsular sinus is not apparent, and lymphoid aggregates extend through the capsule into the perinodal adipose tissue. No normal sinuses or reactive follicles are evident at this magnification. The pattern is consistent with follicular lymphoma, to be confirmed by CD10, BCL6, BCL2 and CD21 immunostains.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles vary in size and shape, have polarized germinal centers with tingible body macrophages and mantle zones, and do not extend into perinodal fat.
NLPHL nodules are larger and contain scattered LP (popcorn) cells in a small B-cell background, identified at higher power and by CD20/OCT2 positivity.
MCL nodules consist of monotonous small cells that are cyclin D1 positive, lacking centroblasts.
